meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: single-store memory injection + memory write tool (the store root holds machine-shared entries, machines/<machine>/ holds machine-private ones), see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel), dispatch_task/dispatch_challenge (workflow v2 assemblers: task drafts the ≤15-line task book per triage tier S/M/L and emits paste-ready dispatch args, forcing a tier upgrade over the diff threshold and logging a start event on output; challenge drafts the independent falsification-gate brief and, given adjudication fields, writes the findings verdict into a gate event; tier and triage line are back-filled from the ledger), dispatch_batch (batch ledger with start/gate/commit/review events; state is folded from the events and legacy six-stage events stay readable), dispatch_lessons (retro helper: covers only batches after the last retrospective event and drafts pairing-rule revision suggestions once due — suggestions only, nothing written back), and usage_note (usage-log note hatch: the recorder listens on host tool-call events and appends this pack's seven tools as a per-day, per-machine jsonl under the memory repo's memory/data/usage-log/ — successful calls keep only the argument key set and duration, failed calls keep the argument summary and error.info, and day files rotate on a 14-day window at write and registration time, synced in the same repo as the batch ledger; hidden snags that structured fields cannot hold get a note/tool/ok line, sharing one timeline with the call lines at retro time).
